name: Long Strap
summary: Buy two calls and one put at the same ATM strike and expiry; a long-volatility trade tilted bullish, twice as sensitive to an up-move as a down-move.

legs.strike_rule: ATM strike, call delta closest to 0.50.
Same ATM strike as the calls.

max_profit: unlimited on the upside (2x the slope of a straddle); (strike*100) - debit on the downside
max_loss: net debit paid (three option premiums), if the underlying finishes exactly at the strike
breakevens: upside: strike + debit/(2*100) per share; downside: strike - debit/100 per share

greeks.delta: positive, roughly +0.50 per unit at entry (2 x 0.50 call delta - 0.50 put delta)

when_to_use: You expect a large move, believe the upside is the more likely direction, and IV is cheap. A strap is the right answer when a binary catalyst has asymmetric upside (approval, upgrade, buyout rumor) but a real chance of a downside gap you still want protection against.
entry_rules: Ratio must be exactly 2 calls : 1 put (GCD = 1, so Alpaca's MLeg engine accepts it; all legs are long so there is nothing to cover).
Upside breakeven distance (debit/2 divided by spot) must be <= 0.75 * the average absolute move for comparable catalysts.
DTE extends at least 5 days past the catalyst.
All three contracts on the same strike and expiry; OI >= 500, bid/ask <= 8% of mid.
Submit as a single MLeg order with leg_ratio 2 and 1.
management_rules: Vol-crush rule: close within 30 minutes of a scheduled event print.
If the underlying rallies and net delta exceeds +1.20 per unit, sell one of the two calls to lock the directional gain and leave a straddle running.
exit_rules: Flat by 15:45 ET on expiration day.

No short legs and therefore no assignment risk -- but all three legs are long, so any ITM leg would be auto-exercised by the OCC at $0.01 ITM, producing up to 200 long shares (calls) or 100 short shares (put) per unit. Close everything before 15:45 ET.
assignment_risk: None from short legs (there are none). The risk is OCC auto-exercise of your own ITM longs at expiry creating stock positions. Eliminated by closing before 15:45 ET on expiry day.
liquidity_needs: ATM strike, so the most liquid on the board. OI >= 500 and package routing.
common_mistakes: Treating it as a cheaper straddle -- it is 50% more expensive; forgetting the asymmetric breakevens (the upside breakeven is much closer than the downside one); running it in high IV.
zero_dte_notes: Theta is 1.5x a 0DTE straddle's. Only defensible in the minutes around a scheduled macro print, and even then a plain 0DTE call is usually the better expression of a bullish-plus-volatile view.
family: Two-leg verticals and same-expiry two-leg combos (call/put verticals, straddles, strangles, guts, synthetics/risk reversals, ratio verticals and backspreads)
